purpose: Frozen transfer, downstream quality, candidate-selection and cost evaluation after bounded development; no selection outcomes used for method choice.

content.selection_basis: Development only. Original CV16 independently tuned by population; graph CV8 fullpool512 and state256 early-cutoff fullpool256 selected after three-start confirmation. Template and original early-cutoff ablations do not replace selected state model. No further method families will be promoted. Candidate0 was used for development; other random subsets are new combinations, genre groups are source-disjoint.
content.primary_comparators: Independently tuned Oracle32, short Oracle32, matched Oracle16/8, zero-gradient Adam control and warmup; matched and practical comparisons reported separately.

timing_plan.qualification: Three interleaved fresh-process repeats per selected adapter, bitwise weight equality required. FLOPs profiled separately on first heldout start; all candidate subsets retain measured training component costs. No timing-based recipe reselection.

content.reference_selection: Independent development Oracle grids, separate candidate1024 and full4097 populations. All three development starts required; fixed before selection readouts.
content.uncertainty: Paired crossed start/premise-group bootstrap, conditional on frozen candidate choices; three starts, descriptive intervals and no automatic noninferiority claim.
content.recipe_choice: No final outcome may select a method, LR, stopping point, behavior model or success threshold.
notes: Primary matched long-horizon arms and development-selected short/tuned arms are reported separately.
The chosen candidate is evaluated under the same population-specific Oracle reference for every selector.
Direct fullpool accuracy uses one4097-example pool per start. Candidate direct accuracy averages the five fixed candidates within each start.
Initial-agent/no-change choice ties all candidates and uses lexicographic order; it is not evaluated as a learned surrogate.
Positive acceleration requires actual time/quality evidence against shorter and independently tuned no-predictor controls, not just lower true-gradient counts.

Candidate0 was also used for development recipe selection; random candidates overlap the original update pool. Genre candidates are the separate group-disjoint training-data transfer condition. All final selection/readout groups remain independent.
content.method_label_note: Fullpool Oracle32 LR.001/256 already exists in blind_matched_jobs under method label oracle32_matched; candidate tuned reference retains oracle32_lr0.0003.

direct_paired_controls_registration.scope: Paired uncertainty for already declared matched/cheap controls, plus the stronger-quality graph Oracle. Native Oracle remains the primary practical reference; no predictor choice is changed.

random_family_train_all_control_registra.scope: Practical no-selection alternative using the already available original4097-example pool. More training examples than a1024-example candidate, explicitly not a fixed-data-size comparison. Uses existing frozen fullpool adapters; no extra recipe search. This control does not cover the union of the five new genre datasets.

direct_training.ready_predictor: Prefix-cache construction, predictor loading, any bootstrap/capture/calibration, and updates through the frozen stop. Use exact-weight qualified standalone repeats for final speed claims; historical rollout components remain separately labeled.
direct_training.standalone: Fresh-process imports, model/data/predictor loading, preparation, updates and final save; common target warmup and offline predictor construction are separate. Require3 distinct repeats, exclude profiler-instrumented time.
direct_training.offline: Union of recorded preparation component dependencies, including source teacher trajectories and source warmups; do not sum shared dependencies twice. Historical sums are not measured cold-start pipelines or minimum achievable costs.

data_selection.families: Random and genre reported separately, one target warmup per pipeline.
data_selection.oracle_exhaustive: Adapt all5 reference-Oracle candidates and score all5 on selection_dev. Reuse the chosen already-trained Oracle adapter; do not add a sixth training run.
data_selection.surrogate_selection: Adapt all5 surrogate candidates, score all5, then add the chosen candidate reference-Oracle training cost.
data_selection.oracle_reference_selector: Any selector that has already trained the exact reference-Oracle candidates reuses its chosen adapter, regardless of generated, forced-teacher, or learned-behavior readout. Other surrogate recipes add one final reference-Oracle training run; check actual adapter/recipe identity rather than selector name.
data_selection.readout: Generated readout uses each recorded generation/grading/serialization timer. Forced readout uses recorded current-teacher or small-model/current-feature timers, plus one readout-prefix-cache construction and, for anchored models, one initial-teacher anchor per warmup/population.
data_selection.initial_agent_selector: A constant initial-agent score ties all candidates, so no candidate simulation or readout is necessary; select lexicographically and train only the chosen reference Oracle.
data_selection.random_choice: No screening; report expected reference-Oracle accuracy and mean training cost across the five candidates.
data_selection.genre_metadata: Choose matching genre for a genre-specific target without model-based search; charge only final reference training.
data_selection.pipeline_status: These are recorded component-sum estimates unless an entire pipeline is directly timed. Model-engine startup, pipeline transitions, data encoding and serialization outside existing timers must remain explicit exclusions/additional costs. Never label component sums measured end-to-end time.
data_selection.evaluation_population: Selection-dev readout costs are deployment selection costs. Selection-holdout and exhaustive ground-truth outcomes used only for research are excluded from hypothetical deployment but retained in total study overhead.

amortization.conditions: Only interpret a break-even at a declared comparable-quality point with demonstrated transfer. If ready cost is not lower there is no finite break-even. Include the final Oracle deployment run for candidate-selection pipelines.
amortization.warning: A practical1pp target is not a statistical noninferiority result; show paired intervals and cheaper no-predictor alternatives.

flops.coverage: Matrix/convolution operations only, actual graph replay/capture executions included.
flops.not_inferred: Offline or readout FLOPs not actually profiled are unavailable, never converted from seconds.
flops.timing: Profiled durations excluded from speed measurements.

measured_selection_pipeline_plan.scope: Fresh full workflow: five independently launched adaptation processes, one fresh readout process, fixed candidate choice, and a final reference-Oracle adaptation if not already trained. Includes process/model startup, serialization and exact-weight/readout verification. Common target warmup and once-only predictor preparation excluded and charged separately. Representative start302 only; three timing repeats are not three scientific seed replications. Code uses existing subprocess boundaries rather than an optimized persistent model server.
measured_selection_pipeline_plan.qualification: All freshly trained weights must be bitwise identical to frozen references. Readout logits/correctness and selected candidate must match frozen dev decisions exactly. No recipe or choice changes from timing outcomes. Separate exact-teacher-only scorer avoids charging learned-behavior features or initial anchors to the teacher control.

budget_scope_clarification.reason: One representative random-family workflow, with six matched readout/short-Oracle controls and three repeats, reserves time for435 frozen readouts and144 independent training timings. Genre workflow costs remain component estimates.

content.status: Prospective rule for remaining development and final recipe freeze; substantial development results already observed and explicitly exploratory. No selection_dev/selection_holdout outcomes observed.

independent_oracle_reference.selection: Highest mean development accuracy over all3 starts; ties prefer lower mean preparation+online seconds, then fewer steps, then lower learning rate

short_oracle_control.selection: Highest mean candidate_0 development accuracy over3 starts among short Oracle32 configurations; same tie rule. Include even if it is also the chosen full reference.

new_method_screening.screening: Use only development results. Prefer accuracy/time Pareto candidates; a candidate must be tested on candidate_0 and starts301/311/321 before a positive generalization claim. Full4097 pool results alone are insufficient for final candidate-size recipe choice.
new_method_screening.confirmation: Fixed shortlist selected from initial development; then confirm on the two additional development starts and candidate_0. Report all shortlisted failures.
new_method_screening.final_choice: Prefer highest mean accuracy among new methods no slower than originalCV16, then fastest configuration within1percentage point of best available development Oracle; if none meet both, retain at most one informative failure for surrogate fidelity rather than claim success.
new_method_screening.stopping: No new method families beyond currently implemented queues without a concrete diagnostic reason; target method freeze around6hours fromstudy start.

content.behavior_readout: Select at most one explicit-state behavior model by predictor_dev teacher logit+state-change error. Retain the no-explicit-delta ablation if used in finalstudy. It reconstructs base H from BF16 stored H, so small rounding-dependent state information may remain; do not call it a mathematically state-invariant control. A separate constant-choice baseline is truly independent of candidate outcomes. Forced-format teacher is mandatory; free-generation outcome is separate.
content.final_outcomes: Do not select a new recipe, stopping point or success threshold from selection_dev/holdout. selection_dev chooses only candidate dataset under each frozen recipe.
content.scope_note: Development LR/horizon selection is exploratory and uses a repeatedly examined small set; final independent source-group readouts and new starts provide the confirmation, with three-start uncertainty limitations.
